g.text: Durable outbound retry, permanent failure and no-duplicate event
canonical mutation + outbox + durable outbound op
provider call(operation UUID, causation, expected revision)
state/projection + one ready event in one transaction
no new outbox or ready event
Last confirmed wins; delete wins stale edit.
Retry survives process/lease failover with same operation UUID.
Echo confirms causation and never loops back.
Current mTLS certificate authenticates Bridge identity.
Whole-account lease/fencing separately authorizes each claim/receipt.
Dispatcher delivers; Bridge never owns public WebSocket connections.
